data analyst.title: data analyst
data analyst.description: Data analysts import, inspect, clean, transform, validate, model, or interpret collections of data with regard to the business goals of the company. They ensure that the data sources and repositories provide consistent and reliable data. Data analysts use different algorithms and IT tools as demanded by the situation and the current data. They might prepare reports in the form of visualisations such as graphs, charts, and dashboards.

business analyst.title: business analyst
business analyst.description: Business analysts research and understand the strategic position of businesses and companies in relation to their markets and their stakeholders. They analyse and present their views on how the company, from many perspectives, can improve its strategic position and internal corporate structure. They assess needs for change, communication methods, technology, IT tools, new standards and certifications.
essential: analyse financial performance of a company
optional: shape organisational teams based on competencies
keep updated on the political landscape
propose ICT solutions to business problems
support implementation of quality management systems

problem: analyse financial performance of a company

database administrator.title: database administrator
database administrator.description: Database administrators test, implement and administer computer databases. They use their expertise in database management systems to plan, coordinate and implement security measures to safeguard computer databases. They also use scripts and configuration files to tailor a database to users' needs.

ICT security administrator.title: ICT security administrator
ICT security administrator.description: ICT security administrators plan and carry out security measures to protect information and data from unauthorised access, deliberate attack, theft and corruption.

ICT help desk agent.title: ICT help desk agent
ICT help desk agent.description: ICT help desk agents provide technical assistance to computer users, answer questions or solve computer problems for clients via telephone or electronically. They provide assistance concerning the use of computer hardware and software.
essential: keep up to date on product knowledge

online marketer.title: online marketer
online marketer.description: Online marketers use e-mail, internet and social media in order to market goods and brands.
optional: deal with pressure from unexpected circumstances

environmental scientist.title: environmental scientist
environmental scientist.description: Environmental scientists identify problems and find solutions in order to minimize environmental hazards by performing analysis on samples such as air, water or soil. They advise on or develop environmental policies and aim to improve water supplies preservation and manage waste disposal sites. Environmental scientists perform environmental risk assessments and analyse the environmental impact of new solutions, construction sites or environmental changes ensuring the environmental regulations are followed.
essential: advise on environmental risk management systems
optional: carry out training in environmental matters
mining, construction and civil engineering machinery products
assess environmental plans against financial costs

esg: advise on environmental risk management systems
coaching: advise on environmental risk management systems

energy assessor.title: energy assessor
energy assessor.description: Energy assessors determine the energy performance of buildings. They create an Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) which indicates what the estimated energy consumption of a property is. Furthermore they give advice on how to improve energy conservation.
essential: advise on heating systems energy efficiency
carry out energy management of facilities
optional: provide information on geothermal heat pumps

coaching: advise on heating systems energy efficiency
energyaudit: advise on heating systems energy efficiency
carry out energy management of facilities

solar energy technician.title: solar energy technician
solar energy technician.description: Solar energy technicians install and maintain systems that collect solar energy. They prepare the necessary fixtures, often on roofs, install solar panels, and plug them into an electronic system including an inverter to connect the solar energy systems to the electricity lines.
essential: follow health and safety procedures in construction
follow safety procedures when working at heights

electrical: follow health and safety procedures in construction
follow safety procedures when working at heights

executive assistant.title: executive assistant
executive assistant.description: Executive assistants are advanced administrative professionals who work with top-level executives or in international facilities in various industries. They organise meetings, organise and maintain files, arrange travel, train staff members, communicate in other languages, and manage the day-to-day operations of the office.
essential: communicate schedules to the people concerned

scheduling: communicate schedules to the people concerned

career guidance advisor.title: career guidance advisor
career guidance advisor.description: Career guidance advisors provide guidance and advice to adults and students on making educational, training and occupational choices and assist people in managing their careers, through career planning and career exploration. They help identify options for future careers, assist beneficiaries in the development of their curriculum and help people reflect on their ambitions, interests and qualifications. Career guidance advisors may provide advice on various career planning issues and make suggestions for lifelong learning if necessary, including study recommendations. They may also assist the individual in the search for a job.
essential: encourage counselled clients to examine themselves
optional: organise projects to fill education needs
encourage students to acknowledge their achievements

customer: encourage counselled clients to examine themselves
coaching: encourage counselled clients to examine themselves

customer contact centre information cler.title: customer contact centre information clerk
customer contact centre information cler.description: Customer contact centre information clerks provide information to customers via the telephone and other media such as email. They answer inquiries about a company's or oganisation's services, products and policies.

office clerk.title: office clerk
office clerk.description: Office clerks are responsible for performing clerical and administrative duties in an office setting and support of business operations within a department. They assist all the administrative staff, secretaries, and assistants by sorting mail, filing forms and documents, answering phones, greeting clients, scheduling meetings, and serving drinks.

bookkeeper.title: bookkeeper
bookkeeper.description: Bookkeepers record and assemble the day-to-day financial transactions of an organisation or company, consisting usually of sales, purchases, payments and receipts. They ensure all financial transactions are documented in the appropriate (day) book and general ledger, and that they are balanced out. Bookkeepers prepare the recorded books and ledgers with financial transactions for an accountant to then analyse balance sheets and income statements.
essential: attach accounting certificates to accounting transactions
optional: archive documentation related to the work

bookkeeping: attach accounting certificates to accounting transactions

secretary.title: secretary
secretary.description: Secretaries perform a variety of administrative tasks to help keep an organisation run smoothly. They answer telephone calls, draft and send e-mails, maintain diaries, arrange appointments, take messages, file documents, organise and service meetings, and manage databases.
essential: communicate schedules to the people concerned
optional: place orders for printed paper goods
develop documentation in accordance with legal requirements

scheduling: communicate schedules to the people concerned

administrative assistant.title: administrative assistant
administrative assistant.description: Administrative assistants perform administrative and office support for supervisors. They perform a variety of tasks, such as answering telephone calls, receiving and directing visitors, ordering office supplies, maintaining the office facilities running smoothly, and ensuring that equipment and appliances work properly.

customer service representative.title: customer service representative
customer service representative.description: Customer service representatives handle complaints and are responsible for maintaining overall goodwill between an organisation and its customers. They manage data regarding customer satisfaction and report it.
essential: perform multiple tasks at the same time
process order forms with customer's information

customer: process order forms with customer's information

call centre agent.title: call centre agent
call centre agent.description: Call centre agents handle incoming or outgoing customer calls for a business. They call existing and prospective customers to promote goods and services. They also obtain sales and arrange sales visits.
essential: perform multiple tasks at the same time
optional: apply operations for an ITIL-based environment

data entry clerk.title: data entry clerk
data entry clerk.description: Data entry clerks update, maintain and retrieve information held on computer systems. They prepare source data for computer entry by compiling and sorting information, process customer and account source documents by reviewing data for deficiencies and verify entered customer and account data.

shop assistant.title: shop assistant
shop assistant.description: Shop assistants work in shops where they perform assistance duties. The help shopkeepers in their daily work such as ordering and refilling of goods and stock, providing general advice to customers, selling products and maintaining the shop.
essential: provide customer guidance on product selection
arrange ordering of products for customers

customer: provide customer guidance on product selection
arrange ordering of products for customers
coaching: provide customer guidance on product selection

receptionist.title: receptionist
receptionist.description: Receptionists are responsible for the reception area of a business. They answer the phone, greet guests, pass information, respond to inquiries and instruct visitors. They are the first point of contact for clients and customers.
optional: develop documentation in accordance with legal requirements

warehouse worker.title: warehouse worker
warehouse worker.description: Warehouse workers execute the accurate handling, packing and storage of materials in a warehouse. They receive goods, label them, check quality, store the goods and document any damage. Warehouse workers also monitor stock levels of items, keep inventory and ship goods.
essential: implement efficiency plans for logistics operations
apply techniques for stacking goods into containers
assist in the movement of heavy loads
handle paperwork related to warehouse stock
types of packaging used in industrial shipments
secure goods according to work orders
match goods with appropriate packaging according to security procedures
optional: apply procedures to ensure cargo complies with customs regulations

cyber: match goods with appropriate packaging according to security procedures
